conventions.pipeline: explicit PROJ pipeline, lon/lat order; {name} placeholders filled from point.params; null pipeline => see pinned_operation.compute
conventions.compare_kinds: lon/lat: degrees, delta converted to metres on GRS80; x/y: metres; x_ftus/y_ftus: US survey feet, delta in metres; h: metres; none: not compared
conventions.delta: delta_m = {horizontal: |dE,dN| metres, vertical: |dh| metres}; signed components in delta.components (proj - expected)
conventions.pass: horizontal <= tolerance_m.h AND vertical <= tolerance_m.v (null tolerance => component not compared)
conventions.expected_alt: other official values for the same point (second path); compared with their own tolerance

_meta.sources_note: Every expected value comes from an agency tool/dataset (expected_source). Inputs marked synthetic are arbitrary test positions.
